notes: DISCONTINUED - captured deliberately under ADR-026. Aer's own product page carries the banner, verbatim: "This item has been discontinued and will not be restocked." The page names and links a replacement, "Travel Pack 28L" (Aer's Travel Pack 4 28L, https://aersf.com/products/travel-pack-4-28l, $239.00, part of the Travel Collection V4 released around March 2026). Rank 4 deliberately KEEPS the Travel Pack 3 Small rather than inheriting to the successor, which is the opposite of what ADR-019 did for the Black Ember Citadel R2/R3: the deciding factor is that the TP3 Small has a real enthusiast score (Pack Hacker 8.6/10, reviewed as the 28L Small specifically) while the Travel Pack 4 has none yet, and `review` is required by sourceSchema. ADR-026 records that deviation; re-visit this capture when Pack Hacker or an equivalent scores the Travel Pack 4 28L. SCORE PROVENANCE - the easiest error here is crossing the two sizes: the 8.6/10 recorded below is from https://www.packhacker.com/travel-gear/aer/travel-pack-3-small/, whose H1 is "Aer Travel Pack 3 Small Review" and which states 28L; the standard 35L Travel Pack 3 scores 9.2/10 at a different URL (/travel-gear/aer/travel-pack-3-2/) and that number must never appear in this file. PRICE VOLATILITY - $229.00 is an end-of-life price on a discontinued SKU and is materially less stable than the other captures in this batch. It is today's regular price, not a clearance price, but sell-through could push it to clearance or remove the product page entirely; re-check before quoting it as current. STOCK, per colorway, read 2026-09-03 brand-direct (the catalog has no stock field, so this is the only record): Black in stock, Olive in stock, Gray sold out, Navy sold out. That state is already moving - an earlier read the same day showed only Black in stock - so treat per-colorway availability as a snapshot, not a fact. All four colorways are still published and priced in Aer's product JSON, which is why all four are recorded here. Captured from the Shopify product JSON (https://aersf.com/products/travel-pack-3-small.json) for variants and image URLs, and the rendered page for the banner and spec block; aersf.com/robots.txt allows /products/ for the wildcard group. COLORWAY HEXES ARE SAMPLED, NOT NAME-DERIVED (re-sampled 2026-09-03). All four come from `pnpm sample-swatch` (scripts/sample-swatch.ts), which implements ADR-025's method verbatim: the median-luminance pixel of the central 40% of the brand's own photograph, background discarded. Each swatchSource is Aer's own hero shot of that exact colorway at this exact capacity - the same four URLs as `images` - so no cross-capacity substitution was needed, and the URLs survive independently of the discontinuation: they are CDN assets, not the product page that ADR-026 warns may disappear. Gray moved almost not at all (#6e6e6b -> #696969), which is the expected result for a name that describes a neutral; Black moved most (#1a1a1c -> #373737), because the guess described the idea of black rather than the photographed fabric. All four names resolve correctly through colorFamilyFromName (black / grey / navy / olive), so no explicit family override is set. Sibling SKUs not captured here: Travel Pack 3 Small X-Pac ($259.00) and Travel Pack 3 Small Ultra ($309.00), both still listed as available, and the standard 35L Travel Pack 3 ($249.00), which carries the same discontinuation banner.
